code='''def transform(grid):
    """Connect consecutive cells of the less common input color by color 3."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    for r in range(h):
        marks = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == marker]
        for left, right in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(w):
        marks = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == marker]
        for top, bottom in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
